purpose: Pixel-CID cross-check: prove Pool's png-crate path yields byte-identical hex to the eye's PIL path.
canonical_algorithm: CID = 'sha256:' + sha256(decoded pixel buffer normalized to 8-bit RGB, no alpha, row-major top-to-bottom, 3 bytes/pixel in R,G,B order).hexdigest()
pool_must_replicate: png-crate decode -> normalize to RGB8 (strip alpha, expand palette, downsample 16->8) -> sha256
cross_check: For each fixture, decode via png crate, normalize, sha256, assert == expected_cid.
load_bearing: rgba8.expected_cid MUST equal rgb8.expected_cid — if they differ, alpha leaked into the hash.

fixtures.note: native 8-bit RGB; the common case, must trivially align
8-bit RGBA, varied alpha; RGB matches rgb8 so its cid MUST equal rgb8's (proves alpha is stripped, not hashed)
16-bit RGB; exercises the 16->8 downsample path. Bytes chosen so >>8 recovers the rgb8 values → cid MUST equal rgb8's.
